content:
Today marks the end of my internship under the Hon’ble Chief Justice of Telangana
This felt like forever but I’m glad a month of long days, hours spent making case notes, navigating through tens of tabs at a time and random chai breaks ended with a positive note!
comment: Court internships often reveal that the real learning lies beyond judgments—understanding how arguments are framed, cases are researched, and judicial reasoning evolves through everyday courtroom processes.
